upload.title: Share your contract

upload.privacyNote: Your contract is not stored. Names, addresses, phone and national ID numbers are removed on our own server before the analysis starts. The result is deleted after a short while.
upload.dropHint: or choose it. Up to {{mb}} MB.
upload.photosHint: Up to {{max}} photos. Photos are made smaller before they are sent.
upload.takePhoto: Take a photo with the camera
upload.sideWorkerHint: The explanation is from the point of view of your rights.
upload.sideEmployerHint: The explanation is from the point of view of compliance.
upload.sampleHint: A fictional contract; nothing to upload.
upload.recordedOnly: This demo can analyse only the sample contract, from the worker's side. Your own contract needs the full version.

results.title: Review of your contract

independence.SAME_FAMILY: A verifier from the same model family

results.recordedNote: {{label}}: this result was built from answers recorded earlier.

citationSheet.title: Legal citation
citationSheet.highlightNote: The green part was matched during verification.
citationSheet.unavailable: The full text could not be fetched now. The verified part is shown below.
citationSheet.quoteNotInText: This part could not be marked separately in the full text.

hero.title: Your job contract, through the eyes of the law.
hero.description: Share your contract. In minutes, see where the risks are, which sections of the law they conflict with, and what to ask to change. Every legal citation is checked against the official source.
hero.scope: No guesswork. If we cannot verify it, we say: uncertain.
hero.sceneAlt: A floating glass contract: an emerald seal on a verified clause, and a broken red glass fragment.

trust.label: What we promise
trust.noInventedLaw: A made-up section is never shown
trust.officialLink: An official-source link with every citation

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.description: From the words of the contract to a verified official source: clear and private at every step.
howItWorks.uploadBody: A PDF, photos or text. A camera photo is fine.
howItWorks.privacyBody: Names, addresses, phone and national ID numbers are removed on our server, then the analysis starts.
howItWorks.reviewBody: Every clause is checked against the law corpus.
howItWorks.verifyBody: A citation is shown only after three checks: the section exists, the quoted words match, and the section supports the claim.

comparison.title: Made-up sections stop here.
comparison.description: A plain AI can name a section number that is not in the law. We check every citation against the law corpus; one that does not match is rejected.

audience.title: For everyone in a working relationship.
audience.workersBody: Understand your contract terms and find the legal sources of your rights.
audience.hrBody: Check the language of employment contracts and your own policies.
audience.ngoBody: Review what could not be verified, and see usage and cost.

limits.title: We say what we know, and what we do not.
limits.uncertain: If something is uncertain, we say so
limits.description: This tool helps you understand a contract; it does not replace a lawyer. A claim that cannot be checked against an official source is never shown as certain.

reason.SECTION_NOT_FOUND: The section is not in the law corpus
reason.ACT_MISMATCH: The act name did not match
reason.SECTION_NOT_CURRENT: The section is not in force now
reason.ACT_NOT_IN_PACK: The act is not in this corpus
reason.NOT_IN_CANDIDATES: The section was not in the list of sections searched
reason.QUOTE_NOT_FOUND: The quoted words are not in the section
reason.QUOTE_BELOW_THRESHOLD: The quoted words do not match the section closely enough
reason.QUOTE_WRONG_LANGUAGE: The language of the quote does not match the section
reason.SUPPORT_PARTIAL: The section supports the claim only in part
reason.SUPPORT_LOW_CONFIDENCE: The support was not certain enough
reason.SUPPORT_CONTRADICTS: The section says the opposite of the claim
reason.SUPPORT_UNRELATED: The section has nothing to do with the claim
reason.VERIFIER_UNAVAILABLE: The verifier model was not available then

why.title: Why is this a risk?
why.retrievedTitle: Which sections of law were searched
why.retrievedBody: {{count}} relevant sections were taken from the law corpus. The analysis can cite only these sections.
why.checkExistence: The section exists and is in force
why.checkQuote: The quoted words match the section
why.uncertainBody: No section passed all checks for this risk, so no citation is shown. It was sent for human review.
why.traceUnavailable: The details of the check could not be fetched now.

redline.title: Proposed new clauses
redline.intro: One proposal for each risk. Struck-through words go, underlined words are added.
redline.noneBody: A new clause is proposed only for a verified risk.

duties.title: Duties
duties.intro: Who has to do what, from the contract and from the law, kept apart.

status.STATUTORY_NOT_IN_CONTRACT: In the law, not in the contract
status.CONFLICTS_WITH_CONTRACT: The contract conflicts with the law

duties.none: No duties were found for this side.

memo.title: Memo
memo.intro: A written summary of your result, to keep or to show a lawyer.

compare.title: Compare with a plain AI
compare.intro: See the same contract two ways: a plain AI, and our system with verification. See which citations survive.
compare.textHint: Paste the contract text (at least {{min}} characters).
compare.baselineNote: This is an unverified answer from one model. We checked the citations below; any that did not match are rejected.
compare.summary: {{rejected}} of the plain AI's {{total}} citations are rejected
compare.summaryMore: {{uncertain}} uncertain, {{verified}} matched. Citations shown in our result: {{shown}}, all verified.
compare.notACitation: This is not a citation, it is the model's claim.
compare.claimVerified: The claim matched in the check
compare.unavailable: The plain AI's answer is not available now.
compare.scripted: This is a scripted example, not a real model answer. Every claim was checked by the real verifier.
compare.noFindings: The plain AI gave no risks.

ticket.title: Status of the human review
ticket.intro: For risks whose section could not be verified, a person takes a look. See where it stands.
ticket.tokenHint: Arriving from the result page, the code is filled in. If you open the page afresh you need to enter it again.
ticket.empty: There is nothing on this ticket.
ticket.notFound: The ticket or the code did not match.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.intro: These change only the language and the style of the explanation. They do not change which risks are found.
